positions.description:
The Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM) is a joint institution of the two universities in Munich, the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (LMU) and the Technische Universität München (TUM).

CDTM offers the interdisciplinary add-on study program „Technology Management“, which is part of the Elite Network of Bavaria. Students from various study backgrounds with creative ideas, great motivation and an entrepreneurial mindset are offered the tools to put their ideas into practice.

As part of the management team, I was responsible for running the daily operations of the Center together with my colleagues, including teaching, designing course formats, acquiring project partners, and ensuring the financial sustainability of the program. In parallel, I was given the chance to pursue a doctoral degree.

company.name: CIP Molecule Technologies
company.description:
CIP Molecule Technologies is a project delivery company working for funds managed by Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) to ensure successful development and construction of Power-to-X (PtX) and carbon capture, use and storage, (CCUS) projects at scale.

CIP Molecule Technologies delivers best-in-class services to CIP’s growing portfolio of PtX and CCUS projects through a combination of best-in-class capabilities and specialized project development and execution. The company facilitate global investments through local presence in key markets, and continuously develop CIP’s expertise in PtX and CCUS by specializing in both existing and new technologies.

CIP Molecule Technologies is jointly owned by the funds managed by CIP and Copenhagen Offshore Partners.
